governing_goal: Prevent repeated user-anchored causal conclusions and explanation-only stopping by making problem evidence, causal modeling, architecture evaluation, bounded intervention selection, execution and V&V one evidence-traced transaction without presuming local, upstream or full-rebuild causality.
incident: Repeated live user corrections showed that policy-level hypothesis-first and root-scope rules did not reliably govern real execution. Repository audit found two independent structural contributors: controlled finalization trusted a precomputed cognition receipt instead of re-deriving the decision from raw evidence, and the legacy root-scope model forced complex/systemic cases into exactly one selected hypothesis. Tests often constructed compliant receipts/contexts manually, so component presence could pass without proving an end-to-end user-correction -> evidence -> causal model -> intervention -> V&V path.
review_hardening: P1 terminal repair/no-change must match the admitted intervention candidate
P1 V&V evidence must bind to the exact planned method rather than only an allowed evidence type
P1 architecture/control interventions must pass executable architecture-experience admission including CURRENT_AGENT dogfood and failure/recovery scenario
P1 selected interventions require substantive current-system evidence and cannot be supported only by a user claim such as rebuild everything
external_learning: NASA-style governing requirement to verification/validation traceability
ATAM-style scenario and tradeoff architecture evaluation
SRE-style recurrent incident learning with contributing causes and concrete corrective action
CAST/STAMP-style avoidance of simplistic single-root causal narratives
next_action: Consume candidate CI/live results; repair any remaining real regressions; then update durable evolution evidence and promote only after all required checks pass.
